weather_report:
As the sun sets in Downtown San Francisco, the sky transitions from a gentle twilight to the velvet hues of night, accompanied by the cool embrace of a marine layer that drapes softly over the city. Currently, the atmosphere is a serene blend of partly cloudy skies, where hints of the lingering fog caress the outer edges of the Golden Gate, suggesting a subdued conclusion to the day. With temperatures resting comfortably in the high fifties, the west-southwest winds whisper through the streets, an invitation for a light jacket or sweater.

As dawn breaks tomorrow, a splendid day awaits, promising sunshine that will gradually warm us with a high close to 70, perfect for those who relish a vibrant, crisp morning. Amidst this clarity, one might choose to stroll along the Embarcadero, savoring the view of boats gliding softly across the water, or perhaps visit a quiet café to enjoy warm pastries while basking in the golden sunlight. Given the forecast, dressing in layers would serve one well, starting with a light shirt that can easily be complemented with a light outer layer as the day unfolds. Embrace the charm of summer in the city, where each sunbeam invites discovery in an ever-enchanting landscape.
